speech.heard: Central African Republic has 322 times the rate found in North Korea. Central African Republic has the world's highest rate at 161 births per 1,000 women ages 15 to 19. At the opposite extreme, North Korea has the world's lowest rate at 0.5. The USA sits at 12.4 births per 1,000 women, while India has 13. China comes in lower at 5.2 births per 1,000 women. Switzerland has 1.5, Kuwait 1.4, Norway 1.3, and Denmark 1.1. What is the adolescent birth rate in your country?
